## What this changes

## Checklist

- [ ] **Focused teaching:** The introduction explains what readers will learn. Content is accurate and task-focused; unrelated caveats and recording mechanics are omitted.
- [ ] **Audience and outcome:** The article declares its target reader and goal in a hidden comment, and delivers the promised outcome.
- [ ] **API documentation:** Guides explain usage and link to the API reference for exact specifications.
- [ ] **Working, consistent examples:** Checked against the current downloadable PeachQ; article commands, outputs and recording agree. Transcripts use `q)` and actual output; `runnable` markers require automated verification as described in CONTRIBUTING.
- [ ] **PeachQ additions:** Use the banner and matching `PEACHQ-SPECIFIC:BEGIN/END` comments, recording the reviewed version and source.
- [ ] **Navigation and links:** New pages have a `title`, `description` and navigation entry. Changed links, anchors and assets resolve; removed pages leave no broken internal links.
- [ ] **Preview:** Changed pages render correctly, including tables, snippets and example controls. Any visual review still needed is noted below.
- [ ] **News posts:** `date`, `categories` and `authors` are set, and authors are listed in `content/news/.authors.yml`.
- [ ] **Shared notices:** Warnings about common issues use the templated notice where available; check the catalogue in CONTRIBUTING before adding one.
- [ ] **Review:** The article was reviewed against its declared audience and goal; findings and fixes are summarised in this PR.
